extraction.Name: Mary Lone Wolf
extraction.Refused/Protested: she thought she had to take the patent, she did not apply for a patent but took it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: deeded the land to Maggie Williams because she could not pay the taxes and the land did not bring her enough money to pay the taxes and she gave it to her daughter to keep for the taxes
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: she could not pay taxes on the land and deeded the land to Maggie Williams because she could not pay the taxes and the land did not bring her enough money to pay the taxes
extraction.NOTES: Deponent makes her home with her daughter and has done so for 14 years; has not received any help from the Government, State or County since she received the patent in fee; was living in Missouri when she received her patent in fee; is not competent and is of poor health, suffering with hardening of the arteries and heart trouble; document sworn December 4, 1928; County of Washabaugh, State of South Dakota | TASK 3 BULK TRIBE INFERENCE 2026-04-29: Tribe field set to 'Pine Ridge' based on directory provenance (record is filed in pine_ridge_*/extractions/, which corresponds to the NARA RG 75 Pine Ridge Vol 1, Vol 2, and Vol 3 bound volumes of Circular 2464 responses). 67 such records were originally 'not stated'; 6 received BLM-confirmed substantive patches in the same transaction; the remaining 61 (this record's batch) are inferred from directory and geographic/naming evidence. Inference is rebuttable — any record can be re-evaluated via BLM cross-reference if its Pine Ridge affiliation is questioned.
